question: Related Questions Q. I want to swap my turn in getting the collected money of a collectivity with another participant from Oct. To April in return for money. Is it halal? 1828 views Q. But my question is that the banks gives profit to government of india(RESERVE BANK OF INDIA) and the same government gives subsidy through public distribution system. gives subsidy to hajis, and gives all infrstructure facilities to people and the money kept of madrasas and masjids which encourage the banks business.Then all above things are jayaz or not jayaz and i have seen that in many muslim countries the preimeses are given to many international banks. 6198 views Q. Jazak ALLAH O KHAIR for helping me. 1646 views Q. Assalam-U-Alaikum. I want to know whether there is a permission in Islam to purchase a car on Installments. As per my knowledge, under installment scheme, you are supposed to pay the actual cost fixed intrest per month. But the cost is predecided by the bank for eg. if the vehicle cost is 4 lakhs, and if you are paying the installments in 3 years, bank will calculate the intrest and give you the final figure of 5.5 lakhs. So the cost of the car is 5.5 lakhs for you, which you are supposed to pay in 3 years. But if you change your plan of making payment in 4 years, then the total value of car will increase. So Please let me know whether we can purchase a car on installment. I can not buy a car by paying entire amount in cash, and car is very important for me to buy. Will be thankful to you for your advise. 2157 views Q. Rail Ticket booking Agent Business 1906 views Q. I want to borrow money from a person working in my office for a period of six months. I will return the money with increased amount. Is it jayez. 1878 views Q. I am an new overseas student at an american university. I was looking for a place to live in the vicinity of the campus and mosque. Me and my friends found a place near to both, but it is owned jointly by the local church and a contractor. The advantage of this apartment over others is that it has a short lease period (I may want to leave for another university in the next 3 months). Is it permissible for me to live in such an apartment when I know that the funds received by the church can go for their activities like preaching (perhaps even to my fellow muslims and/or non-muslims) and worship activities inside the church. I am intending on moving if I get a better accomodation, but the lease is valid for 3 months before which I have to pay a fine for leaving the apartment. I can still however afford to move if it is Haram to live there JazaKAllah, 1611 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 6495 Country: India Title: I am elder son me and my father start doing business by investing equal amount of money,after one year second son also start helping in the business. After seven year father me want to seprat our business due to some dispute. Now pls guide us according shariah how shell we divide our money and property (either purchased or cunstructed) in these years? Question: I am elder son me and my father start doing business by investing equal amount of money,after one year second son also start helping in the business. After seven year father me want to seprat our business due to some dispute. Now pls guide us according shariah how shell we divide our money and property (either purchased or cunstructed) in these years? Answer ID: 6495 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 806/740=L-1429) If the second brother had neither invested his own money in the business nor his salary was fixed then both of you should give him an amount whatever you want, and then divide the rest money as well as the purchased property equally between you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
